notes: §2002:13.16.36.2 SR18: CNT precedes TVG in the CD record, outside the range from the table's first byte to the record end, and is accepted (F1-F3); N, byte 1 of R2, a second record after the same output CD, is byte 1 of T because records after an output CD implicitly redefine one record area (A.1.2.2 SR9), so it lies in the range and is refused. Matched at --std 2002 on the pinned build of dc1f2dcce8 (F1-F3 of the accepted case; g2-occurs-cd-depending-in-other-record refused COBOL0857).
